data.name: A lightweight, self-hosted Kanban workspace for planning boards, tracking cards, assigning work, and sharing progress across your team.
data.value: Lagana, samostalna Kanban radna površina za planiranje tablica, praćenje kartica, dodjelu poslova i dijeljenje napretka s vašim timom.

data.name: Ask for board summaries and guided updates in plain language.
data.value: Zatražite sažetke dasaka i vođena ažuriranja jednostavnim jezikom.

data.name: Authentication, RBAC, OpenID Connect, localization, and system management are included.
data.value: Autentikacija, RBAC, OpenID Connect, lokalizacija i upravljanje sustavom uključeni su.

data.name: Create boards, columns, cards, labels, priorities, and assignments.
data.value: Kreirajte ploče, stupce, kartice, oznake, prioritete i dodjele.

data.name: Create boards, organize columns, and move cards through clear workflow states from idea to done.
data.value: Stvorite daske, organizirajte stupce i pomičite kartice kroz jasna stanja radnog toka od ideje do završene.

data.name: Deploy Kanban in minutes with Docker, SQLite for small teams, or MySQL for larger installations.
data.value: Postavite Kanban u nekoliko minuta pomoću Docker, SQLite za male timove ili MySQL za veće instalacije.

data.name: Everything your team needs to move work forward.
data.value: Sve što vašem timu treba da bi napredovao s poslom.

data.name: Filter your assigned cards by status, labels, and priority.
data.value: Filtrirajte svoje dodijeljene kartice prema statusu, oznakama i prioritetu.

data.name: Group cards with labels, mark priority, assign owners, and surface the most important work first.
data.value: Grupirajte kartice oznakama, označite prioritet, dodijelite vlasnike i istaknite najvažnije poslove na vrh.

data.name: Jump directly into your daily workflow.
data.value: Uronite izravno u svoj dnevni radni tok.

data.name: Keep task context close to the work with descriptions, comments, and public board views.
data.value: Zadržite kontekst zadataka blizu posla pomoću opisa, komentara i javnih prikaza ploča.

data.name: No paid tiers, no hosted lock-in, and no hidden workflow limits. Run it yourself and keep ownership of your project data.
data.value: Nema plaćenih razina, nema vezivanja za hostani sustav i nema skrivenih ograničenja radnih tokova. Pokrenite ga sami i zadržite vlasništvo nad podacima svog projekta.

data.name: Ready to organize your next project?
Review active tasks, owned boards, shared boards, and urgent work.
data.value: Pregledajte aktivne zadatke, vlastite daske, podijeljene daske i hitne poslove.

data.name: Share boards with users or roles, choose read-only or editable access, and keep private work isolated.
data.value: Podijelite daske s korisnicima ili ulogama, odaberite pristup samo za čitanje ili uređivanje i zadržite privatne poslove odvojenima.

data.name: Start with the install script or a single Docker container.
data.value: Počnite s instalacijskim skriptom ili jednim Docker kontejnerom.

data.name: Track assignments, priorities, labels, due dates, overdue work, and active tasks from one dashboard.
data.value: Pratite dodjele, prioritete, oznake, rokove, posao s isteklim rokom i aktivne zadatke s jedne nadzorne ploče.

data.name: Use SQLite for simple hosting or MySQL when your team grows.
data.value: Koristite SQLite za jednostavno hostanje ili MySQL kada vaš tim raste.

data.name: Use the built-in assistant to read board state and help update routine project data.
data.value: Koristite ugrađeni asistent za čitanje stanja ploče i pomoć pri ažuriranju rutinskih podataka projekta.
